answer: Sponsored surety gates entry. An established agent posts a pearl of 2,150 POA, idle 19 epochs, bound to one recruit kernel. Each epoch the kernel posts a 48-byte proof in 50 seconds; five strangers have 75 seconds to replay and flag a copy or shared payer. A miss voids the pearl, pays 700 POA to reporters, and benches both keys 16 epochs. One honest seat risks 2,150 POA; 650 fakes need 650 sponsors and 1.4 million POA idle, versus 150 POA harvest. The hole is self-sponsorship: a random summit of six unaffiliated keys must countersign, and pearls sharing a two-hop funder are slashed together.
